seoTitle: Free Time Zone Converter for Any Date and Time
metaDescription: Convert a date and time from one IANA time zone to several others at once, with DST handled correctly. Free, instant and runs in your browser.
intro: Enter a date and time, a source zone and a list of target zones, and see the same moment in each place, with its UTC offset and weekday.
why:
Scheduling a call between Ghent, New York and Sydney, or checking what time a release lands for a team in another region, gets awkward fast. Offsets change with daylight saving, and not on the same dates in every country, so mental arithmetic breaks twice a year.

This converter uses the time zone database built into your browser, so each result reflects the rules in force on the date you entered. Give the source zone and a comma-separated list of destinations, and you see local time, offset, weekday and abbreviation for each. Leave the time empty to convert the current moment. It runs locally.
howTo: Enter the date and time as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or leave the box empty to use now.
Set the From zone using an IANA name such as America/New_York.
List the target zones, separated by commas.
Read the converted time, UTC offset and weekday for each zone.

faq.q: What are IANA time zone names?
faq.a: Names like Europe/Brussels or Asia/Tokyo from the standard time zone database. They carry the full daylight-saving history, which abbreviations like CET or EST do not. An unknown name produces an error.

faq.q: How does it deal with daylight saving?
faq.a: Offsets are looked up for the exact date, so the same zone can show UTC-5 in winter and UTC-4 in summer. A time that does not exist during a spring change, or occurs twice in autumn, is resolved to a single instant.

faq.q: Can I plan a meeting with it?
faq.a: Yes, for a single time. The Time Zone Meeting Planner compares working hours across several zones, which is easier for finding a slot that suits everyone.

faq.q: Why is the weekday different in some zones?
faq.a: Crossing midnight changes the date. A late afternoon meeting in New York is already the next day in Sydney, and the result shows that date and weekday.
